clips.title: A one-person credit union.
clips.sub: One loan officer, a desk of agents, and every denial reason tested before it is sent.
lines: Cal Hacks 13.0 · Swaraj Adhikari, UCLA · Matthew Pun, UC Berkeley

captions.text: 1 in 4 people who applied for a loan last year were rejected.
A record high, in a $280 billion personal-loan market.
What they get back: “internal standards.” Under Regulation B, that is not a legal reason.
Score codes, black-box models, and now AI that writes the letter and pads the list.
Nobody checks whether the reason is true.
Docket tests every reason before it is sent. In our tests, 16% of AI-written reasons failed and never reached a borrower. 20 of 20 personas matched our answer key.
Docket: a one-person credit union. One loan officer runs a desk of agents.
Six layers: one soft pull, hard stops in code, five lender quotes.
Every decline reason is verified, the notice is written from what survived, and a person signs.
Every applicant is a printed card. Margaret wants $38,000 for a kitchen.
Five lenders quote her at once, on five different policies.
Five written policies read the same file, in parallel. Blue is an offer, amber a decline.
Nothing funds on its own. The agents do the work and escalate the decision to a person.
Every step is in the audit log. Agents are in the seat; a human holds the pen.
Kayla’s identity does not verify, and her CRS fraud score is 88.
Rules in code stop her before any model sees the file. Zero lenders.
Hard stop in code. Zero lenders, zero offers, and the override is refused.
Even the reviewer cannot push it through, and the attempt is logged.
She still gets a notice that tells her how to dispute it.
The part nobody does: for every decline reason, change only that one fact and re-run the lender.
Flip one field, re-run the lender. If the decision does not change, the reason is withheld.
Instead of “internal standards”, the borrower gets the reason that actually decided it, and knows what to fix.
A freeze at one bureau is not a dead end. We underwrite on the other two.
Powered by CRS: three bureaus, identity and fraud in one call.
So we can test the files that break lenders.
Deceased, frozen and synthetic identities.
CREAO hosts every lender as its own agent with its own credit policy, plus a compliance agent that writes the notice.
All of it runs as one Convex workflow: retries, timeouts, a live board, a nightly eval.
That is why we built Docket.
